Good to know

Do I need a skin test?

Yes — for any colour service we need a quick skin test at least 48 hours before. It is free and takes five minutes.

Do you do children’s cuts?

We do, for children aged 3 and over.

Is there parking?

There is a pay-and-display car park 2 minutes’ walk away.
